description: A static helper class for date/time conversions and formatting, handling UTC and local timezone date strings, utilizing PEAR Date library.

classes.name: RV_Admin_DateTimeFormat
classes.description: A static helper class for date/time conversions and formatting, including timezone adjustments and locale-specific formatting.

methods.name: formatUTCDateTime
methods.description: Formats a UTC date/time string into the user's locale and timezone.

methods.name: formatUTCDate
methods.description: Formats a UTC date/time string into a date-only string in the user's locale.

methods.name: formatUTCTime
methods.description: Formats a UTC date/time string into a time-only string in the user's locale.

methods.name: formatLocalDateTime
methods.description: Formats a local timezone date/time string into the user's locale format.

methods.name: formatLocalDate
methods.description: Formats a local timezone date/time string into a date-only string in the user's locale.

methods.name: formatLocalTime
methods.description: Formats a local timezone date/time string into a time-only string in the user's locale.
